info.title: ToolRoute API
info.description:
The OpenRouter for Tools -- unified API gateway for AI agent tools. One API key, 40 adapters, 107 operations. Covers web scraping, TTS, email, LLMs, GitHub, browser automation, documentation lookup, image generation, translation, video production, voice AI, SEO, shipping, payments, databases, social media, and more.

## Adapter Registry (40 adapters)

post.description:
Execute any tool in the ToolRoute registry via the unified gateway. Requires an API key (tr_live_xxx). The gateway routes to the best available provider, handles auth, and returns structured output.

40 adapters available. Use {slug}/{operation} format. Full adapter list in info.description.
